episodes.title: Chapter 1: The King of Comedy
episodes.summary: High off success, The Kid launches a comedy tour in his hometown, but a reunion with his brother and an afterparty lead to a more sobering reality.

episodes.title: Chapter 2: Greek Takeout
episodes.summary: During a full day of obligations and outbursts, Kid leaves Carlton with a daunting task. After an ill-timed photo shoot, the brothers find a solution.

episodes.title: Chapter 3: Victory Lap
episodes.summary: Carlton leverages a video to stave off Ari's brothers, who want money and answers. Kid spreads his generosity, but a misdeed comes back to haunt him.

episodes.title: Chapter 4: We Should Be Together Too
episodes.summary: Brothers come to blows when Kid confronts Carlton. Kid deals with the fallout from his public meltdown and welcomes a new friend into his circle.

episodes.title: Chapter 5: Hard Feelings
episodes.summary: An intense charity gala performance puts Kid at odds with a longtime admirer. Nikos and Savvas snoop at the Four Seasons. Carlton seizes an opportunity.

episodes.title: Chapter 6: The Things You Do for Family
episodes.summary: With Carlton bent on protecting Kid, Gene becomes an unfortunate pawn. After an emotional exchange at the restaurant, Kid makes an unsettling discovery.

episodes.title: Chapter 7: ...Like Cain Did Abel
episodes.summary: Seeking retribution, Kid reaches a breaking point and takes matters into his own hands. Days later, Kid shares his story and vows to be a better man.
